name: Barbell Hip Thrust
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a barbell over your hips.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor.
Push through your heels and lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower your hips slowly to the starting position.

name: Glute Bridge
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your feet about hip-width apart.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips.
Lower your hips slowly without fully relaxing at the bottom.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable pulley and secure it around one ankle.
Hold the machine for balance and stand upright.
Move the strapped leg backward while keeping it slightly bent.
Return the leg slowly and repeat before switching sides.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
steps: Stand a short step in front of a bench and rest one foot behind you on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and keep your torso steady.
Bend your front knee to lower your body under control.
Push through your front foot to return to standing, then switch sides.

name: Cable Pull-Through
steps: Set a cable pulley to its lowest position and attach a rope handle.
Stand facing away from the machine with the rope held between your legs.
Push your hips backward while keeping your back straight and knees slightly bent.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand upright.
